bentAnnulusReference.referenceRadialDependency: the frozen B32 base a(s), a_s(s), a_ss(s); excludes radius-design coefficients

bentAnnulusReference.tailPositionIntegral: Gauss64 in normalized y with exact saturated-ray extension

metricProvider.angularPrimitive: complete quarter-cell Gauss8 with explicit fixed-reference tail breaks and actual first moment; no Fourier projection
metricProvider.angularMetric: exactly a^2 in mathematical complete definition
metricProvider.radialMetric: R181 B32 plus complete C2 radius B-spline design; changing rho changes g
metricProvider.boundary: complete central ellipse cylinder; exact-form R128 bent-annulus outer cut two jets and fixed inner flat cuff
metricProvider.cutHeightSemantics: base.height plus saved cutHeight is the inner flat-cuff plane height; the outer cut mean is lower
metricProvider.radiusGrid: R196 explicit simple nonuniform cubic B-splines, at most four active radial blocks, C2 zero endpoint extension
metricProvider.residual: rE=|Xs|^2-1 and rF=Xs dot T, weighted squared rE^2+2*rF^2
metricProvider.radialQuadrature: Gauss2 on union of original phase/Hermite breaks and spline knots
metricProvider.derivative: complete state and primitive first-moment derivatives, fixed physical s and u
